title: Triangle removal process: exact asymptotics f(n) = Θ(n^{3/2})

problemStatement.formal: ∃ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ ≤ c₂ ∧ ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, c₁ * n^(3/2) ≤ f(n) ∧ f(n) ≤ c₂ * n^(3/2)
problemStatement.plain: The triangle removal process on K_n leaves Θ(n^{3/2}) edges: there exist constants c₁, c₂ > 0 such that c₁·n^{3/2} ≤ E[f(n)] ≤ c₂·n^{3/2} for all large n.
whyMatters: Erdős Problem #1155: fundamental question in random graph processes
BFL (2015) gave n^{3/2+o(1)} but the exact Θ-bound is still open
Connects random graph theory to extremal combinatorics (Mantel/Turán)

proven: BFL sandwich: ∀ε>0, eventually n^{3/2-ε} ≤ f(n) ≤ n^{3/2+ε}
BFL exponent is exactly 3/2: ∀α>3/2, eventually f(n) ≤ n^α
Complete K_n (n≥3) contains triangles (proved for Fin n)
f_small_values_bound: f(0)≤0, f(1)≤0, f(2)≤1 from complete graph bound
open: Full Erdős conjecture: explicit constants c₁, c₂ in Θ(n^{3/2})
knownResults.goal: Prove exact Θ(n^{3/2}) asymptotics or characterize what's needed

currentState.focus: All sorries resolved. Complete formalization of BFL gap analysis.

knowledge.progressSummary: Erdos1155OQ01.lean Docker-verified with 0 sorries (all 10 proved). Key proofs: triangleFree_iff_cliqueFree3, conjecture_iff_both_bounds, bfl_lower_tight, conjecture_implies_bfl_upper/lower (rpow growth via Nat.ceil+rpow_mul), bfl_ratio_characterization (rpow_add), limit_implies_conjecture (Icc_mem_nhds), limsup_liminf_implies_conjecture (div_le_iff₀).
insights: The gap between BFL and the full conjecture is exactly: n^{-ε} vs constant in the ratio f(n)/n^{3/2}
BFL gives n^{-ε} ≤ f(n)/n^{3/2} ≤ n^ε; conjecture needs c ≤ f(n)/n^{3/2} ≤ C
The conjecture decomposes cleanly into independent upper and lower Θ-bounds
If f(n)/n^{3/2} has a positive limit, the full conjecture follows immediately
Fin n literals need explicit ⟨k, by omega⟩ construction when n is variable
SimpleGraph.top_adj works with simp for adjacency in complete graphs
nextSteps: None - all theorems proved. Open conjecture remains stated.

approaches.name: Gap analysis via ratio characterization
approaches.description: Decompose the conjecture into equivalent conditions (ratio convergence, limsup/liminf) and prove structural relationships between BFL and the full Θ-bound.
